# Old Brushtail

*A huge grey-muzzled fox, Disturbance-touched, that outwitted Caddoc's traps for a whole season. It goes where its dust goes. Potions work in its earth; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [Old Brushtail](../monsters/old_brushtail.md) |
| Arena | [Brushtail's Earth](../maps/brushtails_earth.md) |

- Unlocked by [The Cub](../quests/caddoc_the_cub.md)
- Entered by talking to [Torva](../npcs/torva_hunter.md)

**2. Out of the Dust** (below 65% HP): Announces "OLD BRUSHTAIL VANISHES INTO THE DUST!"; moves faster.
